# fw_learn MCP tool

> Run `fw learn` (status, harvest, distill, search, loop). Input schema, parameters and a tools/call example for the fw_learn MCP tool.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/mcp/fw-learn/

Run `fw learn` (status, harvest, distill, search, loop).

## Call it

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "fw_learn",
    "arguments": {
      "action": "status"
    }
  }
}
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | `string: status, harvest, distill, search, loop` | yes | fw learn action. |
| `query` | `string` | no | Search query when action is 'search'. |
